title: Rhythm Context Observation
description: A consented, non-authoritative record of time/calendar context and a human-selected interpretive lens. It cannot grant authority, permission, identity, diagnosis, or execution eligibility.

visibility.description: The user's chosen visibility; public aggregates must not contain direct identifiers.

contains_direct_identifier.description: This schema carries no names, contact data, birth data, relationship details, or raw personal numeric artifacts.

private_source_ref.description: Optional user-controlled reference to a private source. The source content is not included in this record.

timezone.description: Timezone used to interpret local calendar context.

season_label.description: A calendar label, not a causal statement about a person's state.

season_basis.description: How the season label was selected.

lunar_phase.description: Optional calendar-derived label. It makes no claim of causal effect on human experience or action.

kind.description: A user-selected presentation or reflection lens.

selected_by_human.description: No system may infer or apply a personal lens without explicit user selection.

lineage_ref.description: Optional reference to a user-controlled lens lineage. It contains no raw private content.

status.description: A lens may be retired or superseded without retroactively turning it into proof.

summary.description: Optional human-authored summary. It is not a factual claim or diagnostic conclusion.

classification.description: Calibration label. It is not a proof label; a claimed hit requires its evidence route to be recorded separately.

evidence_status.description: Evidence posture for the observation, not a statement about ultimate meaning.

recorded_before_outcome.description: Whether the observation was recorded before the outcome being compared.

counterexample_ref.description: Optional reference to a disconfirming case or review record.

human_disposition.description: The human's current treatment of the observation. Routing creates no authorization.

proposal_packet_ref.description: Optional reference to a separate Proposal Packet if the human asks to move from reflection toward a governed crossing.

receipt_ref.description: Optional reference to a receipt that records this observation event.

authority_effect.description: Invariant: rhythm context has no authority effect. It cannot authorize, widen scope, raise confidence, or cause execution.
